scope: Intake, intent, service navigation and referral cues only. No diagnosis, prescribing, treatment doses or invasive-procedure instructions.

topics.title: Atrial fibrillation
intake: Onset and duration of heartbeat change
warning_signs: Heavy bleeding while on blood thinners
topics.navigation: New symptoms need assessment today; a stable known condition can have a doctor follow-up.

topics.title: Bradyarrhythmias
intake: Whether this is new or a planned review
topics.navigation: Do not infer instability from a condition name; a clinician must interpret pulse and associated symptoms.

topics.title: Heart failure
intake: Known diagnosis and current follow-up plan
topics.navigation: New worsening needs prompt in-person assessment; routine follow-up is different from an acute episode.

topics.title: Stable angina
warning_signs: Sweating or breathlessness with chest pain
topics.navigation: Do not diagnose angina; current red-flag chest symptoms follow the emergency safety contract.

topics.title: ST elevation myocardial infarction
topics.navigation: A suspected current attack needs emergency help; historical discharge/report review does not prove a current attack.

topics.title: Unstable angina / NSTEMI
topics.navigation: Navigation must not calculate a diagnosis or cardiac risk score from incomplete chat data.

topics.title: Acute rhinosinusitis
topics.navigation: Ask about the actual nose/face complaint; doctor assessment can determine whether ENT referral is needed.

topics.title: Chronic rhinosinusitis
topics.navigation: Stable recurring symptoms suit doctor/ENT review; never prescribe antibiotics or decongestants.

topics.title: Nosebleed
topics.navigation: Small stopped bleeding differs from heavy ongoing bleeding; avoid turning the word blood alone into a severity claim.

topics.title: Hearing impairment in children
topics.navigation: Arrange hearing/ENT assessment; delayed speech alone is not a life-threatening emergency.

topics.title: Neck space infection
topics.navigation: Potential airway compromise needs immediate help; uncomplicated throat discomfort needs different questions.

topics.title: Otorrhoea
topics.navigation: Doctor/ENT examination is appropriate; do not suggest ear drops or ear instrumentation.

topics.title: Pharyngitis and sore throat
topics.navigation: A simple sore throat is not automatically an emergency; assess swallowing and breathing before choosing care.

topics.title: Acute kidney injury
topics.navigation: New reduced urine needs medical assessment; never infer kidney failure solely from dark urine.

topics.title: Chronic kidney disease
topics.navigation: Review reports and follow-up needs; do not give blanket fluid, protein or medication advice to kidney patients.

topics.title: Glomerulonephritis
topics.navigation: A doctor must assess urine changes and swelling; do not diagnose from a symptom pair.

topics.title: Urinary tract infection
topics.navigation: Symptoms need assessment rather than an automatic lab order or antibiotic recommendation.

topics.title: Acute paralysis
topics.navigation: New neurological loss needs urgent hospital evaluation; longstanding rehabilitation is a separate service need.

topics.title: Dementia
intake: Gradual memory change versus sudden confusion
topics.navigation: Support patient and caregiver respectfully; do not label normal forgetfulness as dementia.

topics.title: Epilepsy
topics.navigation: Current red-flag seizures follow emergency rules; a stable history can need routine clinician follow-up.

topics.title: Headache
topics.navigation: Do not diagnose migraine or recommend medicines; screen warning signs then offer suitable assessment.

topics.title: Neuroinfections
topics.navigation: Possible acute neurological infection needs urgent in-person care; historical diagnosis alone is not proof of current danger.

topics.title: Stroke
warning_signs: New loss of balance or vision
topics.navigation: Do not delay emergency help for a current stroke pattern while collecting routine details.

topics.title: Antenatal management
topics.navigation: Routine antenatal review is a planned doctor/maternity service; symptoms require targeted assessment.

topics.title: Dilatation and curettage
warning_signs: Fever or marked deterioration after a procedure
topics.navigation: D&C requires a facility; home nursing can support only a stated aftercare task, not perform the procedure.

topics.title: Heavy menstrual bleeding
topics.navigation: Distinguish a routine period concern from active major bleeding; arrange appropriate doctor review.

topics.title: Hysterectomy
topics.navigation: Surgery belongs in a facility; a prescribed wound-care task can use home nursing.

topics.title: Postpartum haemorrhage
topics.navigation: Current heavy postpartum bleeding needs emergency help; do not wait for a home caregiver.

topics.title: Uterine fibroids and polyps
topics.navigation: Doctor or gynaecology review; do not assume surgery is needed from a diagnosis label.

topics.title: Acute encephalitis syndrome in children
topics.navigation: Urgent assessment is guided by the child's reported condition, not a guessed diagnosis.

topics.title: Acute diarrhoea
topics.navigation: Check hydration and age; avoid blanket advice to increase fluids in people with stated fluid restrictions.

topics.title: Dengue fever
topics.navigation: Report warning symptoms without diagnosing dengue or interpreting platelet counts in isolation.

topics.title: Fever in children
topics.navigation: Do not assume every child is an infant; ask age when it changes the safe next step.

topics.title: Sepsis and septic shock in children
topics.navigation: A child with reported danger signs needs emergency care; a fever label alone does not establish sepsis.

topics.title: Severe acute malnutrition with complications
topics.navigation: Nutrition/growth concerns need paediatric assessment; do not score malnutrition from chat alone.

topics.title: Severe pneumonia in children
warning_signs: Chest indrawing or severe breathing effort
topics.navigation: Assess actual breathing and feeding signs; diagnosis and treatment require a clinician.

topics.title: Alcohol use disorders
topics.navigation: Use nonjudgmental language; treatment/withdrawal planning needs a clinician, not unsupervised instructions to stop or change drugs.

topics.title: Anxiety disorders
topics.navigation: Validate distress without promising everything is fine; anxiety does not prove or rule out a physical emergency.

topics.title: Childhood behavioural disorders
warning_signs: Immediate danger to self or others
topics.navigation: Ask respectfully without labelling the child; clinician assessment can guide referral and family support.

topics.title: Childhood emotional disorders
topics.navigation: Provide supportive clinician referral; avoid forcing sensitive details or assigning a diagnosis.

topics.title: Children with developmental problems
intake: Any loss of previously learned skills
topics.navigation: Early paediatric/hearing assessment can help; delayed milestones alone are not an emergency.

topics.title: Depression
topics.navigation: Acknowledge distress and offer doctor/mental-health support; never diagnose from a short message.

topics.title: Psychosis
warning_signs: Unable to care for immediate needs
topics.navigation: Respond calmly without endorsing unusual beliefs; prompt clinician assessment is appropriate.

topics.title: Somatoform disorders
topics.navigation: Treat the distress as real; do not dismiss symptoms as imaginary or assume a psychological cause.

topics.title: Acute respiratory infection in adults
topics.navigation: Symptoms guide care navigation; do not diagnose pneumonia or prescribe antibiotics.

topics.title: Asthma
topics.navigation: Do not label a stable asthma history as a current attack or change inhaler doses.

topics.title: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
topics.navigation: New deterioration needs assessment; do not use a generic oxygen target or treatment plan.

topics.title: Respiratory failure
topics.navigation: Life-threatening breathing symptoms need emergency help; never delay while asking for a device reading.

topics.title: Acute urinary retention in men
intake: Sudden inability versus longstanding poor flow
topics.navigation: Acute retention needs facility assessment; do not send a routine home catheter booking for an undiagnosed acute problem.

topics.title: Gross haematuria
topics.navigation: Visible blood needs assessment; do not infer cancer, infection or harmless food-related colour from chat.

topics.title: Male infertility
warning_signs: Sudden painful scrotal swelling is a separate acute symptom
topics.navigation: Offer a private doctor consultation and specialist referral where appropriate; no emergency from infertility alone.

topics.title: Renal and ureteric stones
topics.navigation: Do not diagnose a stone or recommend expulsive medication; new concerning symptoms require in-person assessment.

topics.title: Scrotal swelling
warning_signs: Sudden severe testicular pain or swelling
topics.navigation: Acute painful swelling needs immediate facility assessment; a stable longstanding swelling needs doctor review.

text.en: Did the headache start suddenly and become extremely painful within minutes?
text.hinglish: Kya sir dard achanak shuru hua aur kuch minute mein bahut tez ho gaya?
text.hi: क्या सिरदर्द अचानक शुरू होकर कुछ मिनट में बहुत तेज़ हो गया?

text.en: Is this headache new or getting worse than usual?
text.hinglish: Kya yeh sir dard naya hai ya pehle se badh raha hai?
text.hi: क्या यह सिरदर्द नया है या पहले से बढ़ रहा है?

why.en: You described a warning sign. Please get medical help now.
why.hinglish: Aapne khatre ka lakshan bataya hai. Abhi medical madad lein.
why.hi: आपने खतरे का लक्षण बताया है। अभी चिकित्सा सहायता लें।

why.en: Thanks for explaining. A doctor can assess the headache today and guide the next step.
why.hinglish: Batane ke liye shukriya. Aaj doctor sir dard ka assessment karke agla kadam bata sakte hain.
why.hi: बताने के लिए धन्यवाद। आज डॉक्टर सिरदर्द की जाँच करके अगला कदम बता सकते हैं।

cues: burning (?:when|while) (?:passing urine|peeing)|burning urine|painful urination|urine (?:burning|problem)|peshab (?:me |mein )?(?:jalan|dard|dikkat|ruk)|baar baar peshab|पेशाब.*(?:जलन|दर्द|दिक्कत|रुक)|blood in urine|पेशाब में खून

text.en: Have you suddenly become unable to pass any urine?
text.hinglish: Kya achanak peshab bilkul band ho gaya hai?
text.hi: क्या अचानक पेशाब बिल्कुल बंद हो गया है?

text.en: Is there fever or pain in your side or back with the urinary trouble?
text.hinglish: Kya peshab ki pareshani ke saath bukhar ya peeth ke ek taraf dard hai?
text.hi: क्या पेशाब की परेशानी के साथ बुखार या पीठ के एक तरफ़ दर्द है?

why.en: You described a warning sign. Please get medical help now.
why.hinglish: Aapne khatre ka lakshan bataya hai. Abhi medical madad lein.
why.hi: आपने खतरे का लक्षण बताया है। अभी चिकित्सा सहायता लें।

why.en: A doctor should assess the urinary symptoms today and decide whether tests or an in-person examination are needed.
why.hinglish: Aaj doctor se peshab ki pareshani ka assessment karwayein. Woh batayenge ki jaanch ya saamne se check karna chahiye.
why.hi: आज डॉक्टर से पेशाब की परेशानी की जाँच करवाएँ। वे बताएँगे कि जाँच या सामने से परीक्षण की ज़रूरत है।

text.en: Are you unable to swallow your own saliva?
text.hinglish: Kya apni laar bhi nigalne mein mushkil ho rahi hai?
text.hi: क्या अपनी लार भी निगल नहीं पा रहे हैं?

text.en: Is the throat or neck swelling getting worse?
text.hinglish: Kya gale ya gardan ki sujan badh rahi hai?
text.hi: क्या गले या गर्दन की सूजन बढ़ रही है?

why.en: You described a warning sign. Please get medical help now.
why.hinglish: Aapne khatre ka lakshan bataya hai. Abhi medical madad lein.
why.hi: आपने खतरे का लक्षण बताया है। अभी चिकित्सा सहायता लें।

why.en: A doctor can assess your throat today and advise if an ENT examination is needed.
why.hinglish: Aaj doctor gale ka assessment karke batayenge ki ENT se check karwana chahiye ya nahi.
why.hi: आज डॉक्टर गले की जाँच करके बताएँगे कि ENT परीक्षण की ज़रूरत है या नहीं।

text.en: Has the hearing suddenly become much worse?
text.hinglish: Kya achanak sunai bahut kam dene laga hai?
text.hi: क्या अचानक सुनाई बहुत कम देने लगा है?

text.en: Is there ear pain, discharge or fever?
text.hinglish: Kya kaan mein dard, paani aana ya bukhar hai?
text.hi: क्या कान में दर्द, पानी आना या बुखार है?

why.en: This change needs a doctor to assess it today.
why.hinglish: Is badlav ka aaj doctor se assessment karwayein.
why.hi: इस बदलाव की आज डॉक्टर से जाँच करवाएँ।

why.en: A doctor can assess the ear or hearing concern today and guide an ENT or hearing check.
why.hinglish: Aaj doctor kaan ya sunai ki pareshani ka assessment karke ENT ya hearing check ka agla kadam bata sakte hain.
why.hi: आज डॉक्टर कान या सुनने की परेशानी की जाँच करके ENT या श्रवण परीक्षण का अगला कदम बता सकते हैं।

text.en: Have the nose or facial symptoms come with a change in your vision?
text.hinglish: Kya naak ya chehre ki taklif ke saath dikhne mein badlav hua hai?
text.hi: क्या नाक या चेहरे की तकलीफ़ के साथ देखने में बदलाव हुआ है?

text.en: Have these symptoms been lasting or repeatedly coming back?
text.hinglish: Kya yeh taklif kaafi din se hai ya baar-baar laut rahi hai?
text.hi: क्या यह तकलीफ़ कई दिन से है या बार-बार लौट रही है?

why.en: This change needs a doctor to assess it today.
why.hinglish: Is badlav ka aaj doctor se assessment karwayein.
why.hi: इस बदलाव की आज डॉक्टर से जाँच करवाएँ।

why.en: A doctor can review the nose or sinus symptoms and guide the right care today.
why.hinglish: Aaj doctor naak ya sinus ki taklif samajhkar sahi care bata sakte hain.
why.hi: आज डॉक्टर नाक या साइनस की तकलीफ़ समझकर सही देखभाल बता सकते हैं।

text.en: Is the swelling happening along with difficulty breathing right now?
text.hinglish: Kya sujan ke saath abhi saans lene mein taklif bhi hai?
text.hi: क्या सूजन के साथ अभी साँस लेने में तकलीफ़ भी है?

text.en: Are you passing noticeably less urine than usual?
text.hinglish: Kya aam se kaafi kam peshab aa raha hai?
text.hi: क्या सामान्य से काफ़ी कम पेशाब आ रहा है?

why.en: You described a warning sign. Please get medical help now.
why.hinglish: Aapne khatre ka lakshan bataya hai. Abhi medical madad lein.
why.hi: आपने खतरे का लक्षण बताया है। अभी चिकित्सा सहायता लें।

why.en: A Medic can assess the swelling and check vitals today. A doctor can guide further tests if needed.
why.hinglish: Aaj Medic sujan aur vitals check kar sakte hain. Zaroorat ho to doctor aage ki jaanch bata sakte hain.
why.hi: आज मेडिक सूजन और शारीरिक माप जाँच सकते हैं। ज़रूरत होने पर डॉक्टर आगे की जाँच बता सकते हैं।

text.en: Have you fainted with the heartbeat changes?
text.hinglish: Kya dhadkan mein badlav ke saath behoshi hui hai?
text.hi: क्या धड़कन में बदलाव के साथ बेहोशी हुई है?

text.en: Is this a new change or happening more often than usual?
text.hinglish: Kya yeh badlav naya hai ya pehle se zyada ho raha hai?
text.hi: क्या यह बदलाव नया है या पहले से ज़्यादा हो रहा है?

why.en: You described a warning sign. Please get medical help now.
why.hinglish: Aapne khatre ka lakshan bataya hai. Abhi medical madad lein.
why.hi: आपने खतरे का लक्षण बताया है। अभी चिकित्सा सहायता लें।

why.en: A doctor should review the heartbeat changes today and decide whether an in-person check is needed.
why.hinglish: Aaj doctor dhadkan ke badlav ka assessment karke batayenge ki saamne se check karna chahiye ya nahi.
why.hi: आज डॉक्टर धड़कन के बदलाव की जाँच करके बताएँगे कि सामने से परीक्षण की ज़रूरत है या नहीं।

text.en: Are you at risk of hurting yourself right now?
text.hinglish: Kya abhi aapko khud ko nuksan pahunchane ka khatra lag raha hai?
text.hi: क्या अभी आपको खुद को नुकसान पहुँचाने का ख़तरा लग रहा है?

text.en: Is this making daily activities or sleep difficult?
text.hinglish: Kya isse roz ke kaam ya neend mein dikkat ho rahi hai?
text.hi: क्या इससे रोज़ के काम या नींद में दिक्कत हो रही है?

why.en: You described a warning sign. Please get medical help now.
why.hinglish: Aapne khatre ka lakshan bataya hai. Abhi medical madad lein.
why.hi: आपने खतरे का लक्षण बताया है। अभी चिकित्सा सहायता लें।

why.en: Thank you for sharing this. A doctor can listen and help you find suitable support today.
why.hinglish: Yeh batane ke liye shukriya. Aaj doctor aapki baat sunkar sahi support dhoondhne mein madad kar sakte hain.
why.hi: यह बताने के लिए धन्यवाद। आज डॉक्टर आपकी बात सुनकर सही सहायता ढूँढने में मदद कर सकते हैं।

cues: memory (?:loss|problem)|keeps forgetting|baar baar bhool|yaaddasht|याददाश्त|बार बार भूल

text.en: Has the person suddenly become confused or hard to wake?
text.hinglish: Kya achanak uljhan hui hai ya unhe jagana mushkil ho raha hai?
text.hi: क्या अचानक उलझन हुई है या उन्हें जगाना मुश्किल हो रहा है?

text.en: Is the memory change affecting everyday activities?
text.hinglish: Kya yaaddasht ka badlav roz ke kaam par asar daal raha hai?
text.hi: क्या याददाश्त का बदलाव रोज़ के काम पर असर डाल रहा है?

why.en: You described a warning sign. Please get medical help now.

why.hi: आपने खतरे का लक्षण बताया है। अभी चिकित्सा सहायता लें।

why.en: A doctor can review the memory changes and help you and your family plan the next step.
why.hinglish: Doctor yaaddasht ke badlav ko samajhkar aap aur parivar ko agla kadam bata sakte hain.
why.hi: डॉक्टर याददाश्त के बदलाव को समझकर आपको और परिवार को अगला कदम बता सकते हैं।

text.en: Is there heavy ongoing bleeding with faintness or feeling very unwell?
text.hinglish: Kya abhi bahut khoon beh raha hai aur behoshi jaisa ya bahut bura lag raha hai?
text.hi: क्या अभी बहुत खून बह रहा है और बेहोशी जैसा या बहुत बुरा लग रहा है?

text.en: Could you be pregnant, or have you recently given birth?
text.hinglish: Kya pregnancy ho sakti hai ya haal mein delivery hui hai?
text.hi: क्या गर्भावस्था की संभावना है या हाल में प्रसव हुआ है?

why.en: You described a warning sign. Please get medical help now.
why.hinglish: Aapne khatre ka lakshan bataya hai. Abhi medical madad lein.
why.hi: आपने खतरे का लक्षण बताया है। अभी चिकित्सा सहायता लें।

why.en: A doctor can assess the period concern today and guide appropriate women's health care.
why.hinglish: Aaj doctor period ki pareshani ka assessment karke sahi women's health care bata sakte hain.
why.hi: आज डॉक्टर माहवारी की परेशानी की जाँच करके सही महिला स्वास्थ्य देखभाल बता सकते हैं।

text.en: Did severe testicular pain or swelling start suddenly?
text.hinglish: Kya andkosh mein tez dard ya sujan achanak shuru hui?
text.hi: क्या अंडकोष में तेज़ दर्द या सूजन अचानक शुरू हुई?

text.en: Is there fever or a recent injury with it?
text.hinglish: Kya iske saath bukhar ya haal ki chot hai?
text.hi: क्या इसके साथ बुखार या हाल की चोट है?

why.en: You described a warning sign. Please get medical help now.
why.hinglish: Aapne khatre ka lakshan bataya hai. Abhi medical madad lein.
why.hi: आपने खतरे का लक्षण बताया है। अभी चिकित्सा सहायता लें।

why.en: A doctor should assess the pain or swelling today and guide an in-person examination.
why.hinglish: Aaj doctor dard ya sujan ka assessment karke saamne se check karne ka agla kadam bata sakte hain.
why.hi: आज डॉक्टर दर्द या सूजन की जाँच करके सामने से परीक्षण का अगला कदम बता सकते हैं।
